messages:
Mike: FYI opened a small PR to sync env vars between /configs/infra and /configs/ml — we need sign-off from both ops and ML. PR: https://git.redwood/infer/pull/4123
Irene: looking now. quick question — CODEOWNERS currently has `/configs/infra @eng-ops` but nothing for `/configs/ml`. this will block auto-approvals.
Sam: can we add a CODEOWNERS line that covers both dirs or add a single `@eng-platform` owner to avoid dual approval friction?
Maya: I can review the ML-specific parts, but if ops wants to keep final say on infra-related vars that's fine. pinging @Irene for ops sign-off.
Mike: PR is mostly renaming keys + moving shared defaults. not changing behavior. splitting into separate commits would be fussy.
Irene: if it truly doesn't change runtime behavior ops can give a quick 👍 once CI passes. otherwise we should get both approvals.
Sam: suggestion: add this to CODEOWNERS temporarily: `
/configs/ @eng-platform @eng-ops @eng-ml
` then remove `@eng-platform` once owners settle. that lets one team approve for now.
Maya: prefer not to touch owners lightly. alternative: add a one-off `approver: Maya` label and have an approver-bot grant a proxy approval for this PR.
Mike: okay — which is faster? we need to unblock a canary rollout later today.
Irene: proxy approval sounds fine to me for a non-behavioral change. @Sam can you trigger the approver-bot or tell me the command?
Sam: sure — run `./scripts/approve-proxy --pr 4123 --reason "sync-configs non-behavioral" --expires 2h` and the bot will add an approval event.
Maya: running a quick pass now. small nit: env var `ML_LOG_LEVEL` renamed to `ML_VERBOSE` — please confirm consumers handle both.
Mike: verified in the service that reads both keys, fallback present. added a tiny test.
deploy-bot: CI build 4123: unit ✅ integration ✅ lint ✅ (build time 7m32s).
Irene: +1 from ops. small comment about docs path, not blocking.
Maya: +1 from ML, ran local smoke test.
Sam: proxy approval applied by approver-bot (expires in 2h). tagging for merge after a 5m wait to let canary window open. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Mike: merging now. thanks all. :wave:
deploy-bot: PR 4123 merged to main by Mike. deploy job started.
